UUIDType
An ExtendedType for java.util.UUID that picks the storage format from the JDBC type of the mapped column: character columns store the canonical 36-char string; binary columns store the 16-byte big-endian form, most significant bits first; anything else is passed to the driver as an object, which is how a PostgreSQL native uuid column works.
